desktop.notes: Nexora AI given per user in Authorizations. Find mode (Ctrl+F) and a Find button; search finds by words. Item master's extra fields as your own fields, with your own tabs. Administration menu in folders; module colours everywhere. Right-click an item for Inventory movement, Inventory audit and Item status. Form Settings on the action bar, the same on every computer, and given to others from Administration. HSN / GST from the item group. Prints fit the page. 164 formula functions.
